items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-03-22
items.q: We played on the same ticket with B.B. King at the Blue Eagle.

ctx.x: Okay, we talked about, you mentioned the Blue Eagle. Blue Eagle. Okay. Was that a rougher club than say?

Yes, sir. When you say the Blue Eagle, you say it's a rough neighborhood, rough club, rough people, used to come into Blue Eagle. You would guarantee on a dance night at the Blue Eagle, guarantee a fight. It was like automatic. You know somebody was going to get their head bust or something. You know, it wasn't that much killing back then. But they would fight. Somebody might get, occasionally you would hear somebody would get shot or something like that. But it's very occasional. But, you know, like I always…
Were there any problems with whites going to the Dewdrop?
